name: Fleet PR Code Review
description: Reviews Fleet pull requests for bugs, security, and project standards, then comments on the PR.

prompts:
Review the pull request diff for the Fleet personal garage app.

Focus on:
- Correctness and likely bugs in vehicles, maintenance, research, and auth flows
- Readable naming over comments (prefer clear names; comments only for non-obvious why)
- React feature-folder patterns under src/features and app chrome under src/app
- Supabase safety: browser code must use only the anon/publishable key; never introduce service_role or secret keys into Vite env or client code
- Data changes must preserve user_id ownership and Row Level Security expectations
- Risky or incomplete migrations, auth/session gaps, and insecure redirect/config changes

Post one concise PR comment with findings grouped as Critical, Suggestion, and Nice-to-have. If nothing material is wrong, say so briefly and note any residual risks.
